normal_close.trigger: Peer sends RFC 6455 Opcode 8 Close Frame
normal_close.server_action: Server echoes close frame, terminates reader/writer goroutines, closes socket
normal_close.state_cleanup: Removes peer connection from active maps, updates registry counts

evidence.detail: Gorilla close frame handling and defer cleanup

abrupt_close.trigger: TCP connection reset / network drop / 60s read deadline timeout
abrupt_close.server_action: Reader goroutine encounters io.EOF or net.ErrClosed, invokes defer cleanup
abrupt_close.state_cleanup: Removes peer from session maps, decrements client_count, broadcasts update

evidence.detail: Defer cleanup routine triggered on read deadline error or EOF
Protocol error triggers abrupt connection drop and peer cleanup

device_disconnect.registry_mutation: Device.online set to false; Device.last_offline set to current timestamp
device_disconnect.broadcast: device_list_update emitted to all connected clients

client_disconnect.registry_mutation: Device.client_count decremented; client removed from Device.clients array
client_disconnect.broadcast: device_list_update emitted to all remaining clients
